procedure_text: 向反应瓶中加入叔戊醇50mL和叔丁醇150mL，开动搅拌，室温下将14.0g氢化钾(30％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢化钾溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.2％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
procedure_summary: The methyl benzoate ester is cleaved by potassium hydride in a mixture of tert-amyl alcohol and tert-butanol, the hydride being charged first and dissolved before the ester is added, and the mildly exothermic mixture is held at a controlled vessel temperature. In-process liquid chromatography establishes the content of the potassium benzoate salt, after which the solvent is stripped under reduced pressure and the residue is taken straight into the etherification without isolation.
notes: Chinese heading [0132] (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备 (preparation of a 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt). The document marks its two experimental steps (1) and (2), not N、 as the rendered pass prompt says; step_label follows the run convention Step N and the document's own marker is recorded here. NAMING: the heading names the product generically as the benzoate salt while the prose of the same step names the potassium salt; the A1 identifier for the potassium salt is used and the generic heading form is one of its aliases, so no translation_conflict is raised. CLASS: the patent calls this 碱解反应 (alkaline decomposition). It cleaves the methyl ester to the alkali metal carboxylate and leaves the benzylic bromide untouched, so hydrolysis is the closest available reaction_class even though the medium is anhydrous tertiary alcohol and the true mechanism is base promoted ester cleavage rather than addition of water; ester_formation is the reverse transformation and salt_formation alone would lose the ester cleavage. Confidence is medium for that reason. TEMPERATURE: the hydride is added at 室温 (room temperature), then the vessel is held at 25 C for the ester charge and for the whole reaction, so the structured temperature is the 25 C hold and the room temperature addition is recorded in the hydride's addition_profile. REACTOR: the text charges 反应瓶 (reaction flask) but then speaks of 釜温 (vessel temperature) and 倒入釜中 (poured into the vessel); reactor_type keeps the flask as first written and the mixed wording is recorded here. No volume is printed. STIRRING: 开动搅拌 says only that stirring was started, so stirring.type is left null. POTASSIUM HYDRIDE: printed as 14.0g氢化钾(30％，0.105mol) and 滴入, added dropwise, then described as dissolving completely. A solid pyrophoric hydride is neither added dropwise nor dissolved in a tertiary alcohol without reacting, so the wording is internally odd, but it is transcribed exactly as printed and no strength, form or diluent is inferred. The mass, the 30 percent strength and the stated moles do close against the molecular weight of potassium hydride, so molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised. ARITHMETIC: every printed mass, strength and mole triple in this step closes against the compound named; no product mass or yield is printed for step (1), only an in-process chromatographic content, so there is nothing here that can fail to close. Full working is in the provenance sidecar. DRAWING: the scheme at line 449 draws the methyl ester going to the potassium benzoate over KH, which agrees with the prose on the reagent, on the alkali metal and on the product, so no drawing_text_conflict. The two tertiary alcohol solvents are written but not drawn on the arrow; solvents are conventionally omitted from these schemes and no reagent, catalyst or base is missing, so reagent_written_not_drawn is not raised. NO ISOLATION: the solvent is stripped and the material goes straight into step (2), so no product mass exists and purification is null. PROVENANCE OF THE READING: extraction by Claude (Opus 5), reading the enriched numbered markdown and the vision pass drawings.

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF、13.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.135mol)和9.9g氢氧化钾(85％，0.15mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应5h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.5g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.1％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.1％。
procedure_summary: Trifluoroethanol and potassium hydroxide in DMF are cooled, and the potassium benzoate salt from the preceding step is added in portions so that the trifluoroethoxide displaces the benzylic bromide, the mixture then being held at temperature. The solvent is stripped under reduced pressure, the residue is dissolved in water and acidified dropwise with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated benzoic acid is filtered off, rinsed with water, dried and assayed by HPLC.
notes: Chinese heading [0135] (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备 (preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid). CLASS: the benzylic bromide is displaced by trifluoroethoxide generated in situ from trifluoroethanol and potassium hydroxide, so nucleophilic_substitution with the Williamson ether synthesis as the named reaction. ONE POT: is_one_pot is false. The alcohol and the base are charged together and the prose never describes the deprotonation as a transformation of its own, and this section pre-forms no alkoxide, so there is no separate alkoxide record to make; the concentrated hydrochloric acid is a workup acidification that converts the carboxylate to the free acid on the way to isolation, recorded in workup with ph_target, not as a second reaction. LINKAGE: the text says 步骤(1)制备得到的, the material obtained in step (1), and the reactant identifier is the step (1) product identifier, so precursor_step is Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true on both of rule 24's tests. ADDITION: the benzoate salt is added 分八次, in eight portions, over a total addition time of 3 h, which belongs in that compound's addition_profile; time_h is the 5 h hold after addition was complete, per the rule that an addition time is not a reaction time. REACTOR: charged as 反应釜 (reaction vessel) but the salt is said to be added 加入反应瓶中 (into the reaction flask); reactor_type keeps the vessel as first written and the mixed wording is recorded here. STIRRING: 开动搅拌 only, so stirring.type is null. YIELD: the printed 收率 is explicitly 两步反应收率, a two-step yield taken on the methyl ester charged in step (1), not a yield for this step alone. It is recorded as printed in product_yield_pct and this note is the only place that distinction is carried. ANALYTICS: the HPLC figure is a quantitative assay of the isolated product, so it is product_purity_pct and not process_control; step (2) states no in-process monitoring. ARITHMETIC: the trifluoroethanol and potassium hydroxide mass, strength and mole triples both close against the compounds named, and the printed product mass, the printed content and the printed two-step yield are mutually consistent against the named product, so no mass_balance_implausible and no molar_mass_inconsistent. Full working is in the provenance sidecar. This is a case where the rendered prompt's claim that the mass and mole pairs repeatedly fail is a statement about the reference patent and not about this section. DRAWING: the scheme at line 456 draws the potassium benzoate going to the acid with CF3CH2OH, KOH and HCl on the arrow, all three written in the prose, and it agrees with the prose on potassium in both the salt and the base, so no drawing_text_conflict and no reagent flag. DMF and the workup water are written but not drawn, which is the ordinary omission of solvent and workup agent from a scheme. PROVENANCE OF THE READING: extraction by Claude (Opus 5), reading the enriched numbered markdown and the vision pass drawings.
